Mat - Runner & Foodie
Barcelona, Spain3105 contributions

Good food
Dec 2024 • Family
Have you ever had goat 🐐 meat?
Goat meat does not sound strange to me. I've always had goat meat. In fact, one of the best meals of my life happened to be a goat meat stew 🍲 in Cuba 🇨🇺.
But I know that for many Europeans 🇪🇺 or North Americans 🇺🇲, eating goat sounds like a weird idea.
In Ninh Binh, Vietnam 🇻🇳, it seems that, like duck 🦆, goat 🐐 meat is a local delicacy. So my brother in law took us to a place called Minh Toàn Father Cooking Restaurant, on Tam Cốc Road to try some of their specialties.
We shared a couple of dishes of goat and we also tried a few other items like fresh Spring rolls.
Everything was good. 👍 Now was it the meal of my life? No, definitely not.
We had the chance to eat on the terrace and the place was not too busy so the staff could attend us properly. 👍
We paid VND192K per person for not too much food and a few drinks but no desserts. That probably was our most expensive meal in Vietnam 🇻🇳... but that was still less than €7! 😅

Quality & taste: 8/10
Quantities: 7/10
Atmosphere: 8/10
Originality: 8/10
Ratio price / quality: 7/10
Service: 8/10
How I felt afterwards: 8/10

More on IG: @runnerandfoodie
